goals.outcome: With --cloudflare the console runs the tunnel itself and reports the tunnel as connected on the machine.
From outside the home a phone opens the console name through the Cloudflare edge, meets the sign-in wall, signs in with a Secure cookie and gets live updates.
The tunnel lives only while Castraferrum runs: cloudflared is a child of the console process.
The token never shows in a command line or a log of Castraferrum.
The home path is closed: nothing on the PC answers on ports 80, 443 or 7070 from the network.
